declaration: Corrected-input declaration after an invalid colour-selection pilot and enlarged-axis QA, before corrected-input fitting. Exploratory energies were already seen. Not blinded or preregistered; windows and models unchanged.
transformed_check: Fig6C corrected ordinate, use all recovered finite columns; T=1000/x, signal=exp(z); not raw-spectrum validation
pixel_cases: Primary window, graphical-zero baseline, T shifted +/-1.5 pixel and signal shifted +/- extraction bound; no probability/coverage meaning
input_screen: Strictly increasing spectrum T; >=5 positive pairs per leading edge; >=30 pairs whole peak; no gap filling or smoothing
comparison: Uncorrected ln(signal) slope approximates n=0; published corrected ln I - n ln theta uses n=0.02. Reference uncertainty is descriptive, not a pass criterion.
stopping_rule: One pass of four leading-edge cases, four primary engineering corners, two whole-peak diagnostics and one transformed-plot reconstruction. Preserve all outputs/failures; do not tune windows to published energy.
weights: Uniform per recovered raster column; correlated source pixels. No independent-sample CI or MC interpretation.
full_peak_role: Stress test of a single ideal zero-order state against a two-phase/broadened experimental profile; not same estimand as rising-edge reference.
